about: Known differences from Kotlin's PSI parser, read by tools/cross-validation/diff-run.js --expect. Each entry: key, a regular expression over a bucket key; status, deliberate (a difference the grammar keeps, with the Kotlin rule it departs from and the cost of matching it) or open (a gap the gate found, not fixed yet); reason; counts, the inputs per corpus it covers, more of which fail the gate; example, the smallest input of the bucket when it was registered. A gated bucket no entry names fails tools/psi-gate/run.sh, so a new difference shows at once; fixing an open one removes its entry.
